Man reading about the projectiles shit has me worried. If there's one thing I want to see from THPS in it's return, I want to see the series' suspension of reality but focus on the gameplay that has you moving around rushing to get stuff done. THPS 1-3 just felt so right, everything that followed just got blander and blander.

Enough of the static world roaming that THPS4 introduced. None of the MTV Jackass shit that killed Underground 2 and the series. None of the angsty teenage coming of age story complete with teenage drama in American Wasteland. Tell whoever thought it was a good idea to throw in gimmicky motion/tilt controls that they can go packing. You know, maybe the story could just focus around a group of skaters goading each other to do more and more ridiculous stunts and have the focus be on the crazy shit they do?

I want to be able to ollie clear across a mountain valley at top speed. I'd like a full downhill level where you're not supposed to ever touch the ground. Levels that contain variety in setting, and stuff to do. Maybe an open world isn't the solution. I still remember the allure of unlocking an area through a grind for the first time in THPS2's Hangar. I just want the game to go back to being a game as opposed to a skating simulator or interactive episode of Jackass.
